singleSourced.context: A 2023 assessment found Kurtaj had "acute autism" and was determined to return to "cybercrime" as soon as possible, despite the fact that he was literally standing trial for doing cybercrimes.

He also pleaded guilty to assaults on workers while in custody, which the BBC report says included "multiple biting incidents."

As I said when Kurtaj was moved from hospital to prison, the whole thing strikes me as odd.

If you haven’t seen No Country for Old Men, you’ll probably ignore this advice and pocket the dough for a cool $25,000.
